༄༅/ /thugs rje chen po tshom bu lugs kyi dmar khrid kyi brgyud 'debs bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /thugs rje chen po tshom bu lugs kyi dmar khrid

kyi brgyud 'debs bzhugs/ na mo gu ru/ spyi gtsug pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan steng du/ /drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma spyan ras gzigs/ /gsol ba 'debs so bskyed rdzogs mthar phyin nas/ / myur du sangs rgyas thob par byin gyis rlobs/ /rgyal ba stobs bcu'i dbang phyug rdo rje 'chang*/ /rgyal yum 'gro ba'i 'dren mchog bdag med lha/ /rgyal sras grub pa'i dbang phyug tshom bu pa/ /gsol ba 'debs so bskyed rdzogs mthar phyin nas/ /myur du sangs rgyas thob par byin gyis rlobs/ /byang chub dar ma 'od zer spyi yi lha/ /chos rje byang chub tshul khrims brag dmar ba/ /snying po'i don gzigs lha btsun dgon gsar ba/ /gsol ba 'debs so bskyed rdzogs mthar phyin nas/ /myur du sangs rgyas thob par byin gyis rlobs/ /rgyal ba gnyis pa thugs rje brtson 'grus zhabs/ /mkhas pa'i dbang po chos rje shes rab 'bum/ /rgyal ba'i sras po thogs med dngul chu ba/ /gsol ba 'debs so bskyed rdzogs mthar phyin nas/ /myur du sangs rgyas thob par byis gyis rlobs/ /mkhyen brtse'i rang bzhin chos rje rgyal mtshan zhabs/ /skad gnyis smras pa'i dbang po ngag dbang grags/ /dngos grub mchog brnyes dkon mchog rgyal mtshan la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bskyed rdzogs mthar phyin nas/ /myur du sangs rgyas thob par byis gyis rlobs/ /mkhas btsun dam pa kun dga' mchog grub zhabs/ /'jam mgon grub pa'i dpa' bo grol mchog rje/ /rgyal tshab dam pa lung rig rgya mtsho la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bskyed rdzogs mthar phyin nas/ /myur du sangs rgyas thob par byis gyis rlobs/ /thams cad mkhyen pa kun dga' snying po'i zhabs/ /sngon sbyangs dam pa rin chen rgya mtsho ste/ /bstan pa'i srog shing blo gros rnam rgyal la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bskyed rdzogs mthar phyin nas/ /myur du sangs rgyas thob par byin gyis rlobs/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i spyi gzugs chos kyi rje/

/drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che/ /yab sras brgyud par bcas pa thams cad la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bskyed rdzogs mthar phyin nas/ /myur du sangs rgyas thob par byin gyis rlobs/ /skyabs 'gro sems bskyed zung sbyor sngon 'gro dang*/ /bskyed rdzogs zung sbyor dngos gzhi'i nyams len sogs/ rjes spyod chu bo rgyun gyi rnal 'byor gyis/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang go 'phang myur thob shog /ces pa'ang ngag dbang kun dga'i ming can gyi gzhan gyis bskul ngor jo nang dpal rir bris/ /bkra shis/ dge'o/ /zhus dag / mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/thugs rje chen po tshom bu lugs kyi dmar khrid kyi brgyud 'debs bzhugs/ PAGE 203- 204 -- PAGE 203 -- PAGE 202 -
